correctness.rationale: The exact two-variable qf atomic diagrams on (0,x,y) have, for odd characteristic at least five, exactly five exceptional scalar slopes 0,1,-1,2,1/2 plus a generic diagram. Pair atomic types encode the zero/nonzero status of each coordinate. Replacing either variable while the other is held zero or nonzero yields precisely the same repertoire within each of the six claimed classes, so matching complete pair types is a two-pebble back-and-forth invariant for all finite play lengths. Distinct classes have different realizable pair diagrams and are separated by rank-two existential conjunctions of their atomic diagrams. Exact full pair enumeration for fifteen small structures confirms all six classes and the sharp nine-element bound. The all-prime, all-dimension, all-depth conclusions follow from the symbolic slope and bisimulation arguments, not from finite testing.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification of all two-variable sentences without a quantifier-rank cutoff on the natural two-parameter family of prime-field additive groups. It separates variable-width expressibility from depth: thirteen unrestricted rank-three theories collapse to six even under arbitrarily deep two-variable formulas. The unexpected equivalence between groups of orders 25 and 7 and the sharp nine-element representative bound reveal nontrivial structural information and are not implied by fixed-rank prior work.
